headline: Bangladesh Sets Dec. 1 Start for Garment Pay Revision
deck: Bangladesh’s wage board agreed a Dec. 1 start for a revised garment-pay structure, with reports putting workers’ first revised salaries in January 2027.
body: Bangladesh’s garment wage board agreed that its revised pay structure will take effect on Dec. 1; bdnews24.com said workers will receive the revised wages when December salaries are paid. [E1]

Workers say food, housing, transport and healthcare costs have eroded purchasing power amid 8% inflation; they are seeking a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka ($240), a 140% increase from 12,500 taka. [E2]
The government set up the board on Sunday, with employer and worker representatives, to negotiate a pay rise; it has not specified the size of the increase. [E3]

The Daily Sun report cited in the Nov. 5 coverage said revised wages would be paid with January salaries. [E4] Financial Express and The Daily Star now specify January 2027 as the first pay under the new scale. [E5] [E6]
